context.body: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

context.body: Succession, Retelling, and Temple Preparation · 1 Chronicles 16:1–43
context.label: Canonical location

observations.body: Offerings, blessing, food, appointed Levites, a thanksgiving psalm, regular service, named musicians, and David’s return home follow the ark’s arrival.
observations.label: Worship is assigned before the ark: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps David, priests, Levites, singers, Israel, and each household, the ark’s tent, Gibeon’s tabernacle, and David’s house, offering, blessing, distributing, appointing, thanking, remembering, serving, and returning visible within David's story or later memory.
observations.label: Worship is assigned before the ark: action, promise, or consequence

observations.body: David, priests, Levites, singers, Israel, and each household · the ark’s tent, Gibeon’s tabernacle, and David’s house · offering, blessing, distributing, appointing, thanking, remembering, serving, and returning · celebration becomes an ordered continuing ministry
observations.label: Relationships named in 1 Chronicles 16:1–43

payload.posture: Read 1 Chronicles 16:1–43 as its own succession, retelling, and temple preparation David setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places celebration becomes an ordered continuing ministry inside this David setting without explaining every motive, transition, or later consequence.
payload.title: Worship is assigned before the ark
